title: Two-Ingredient Cream Biscuits
description: You only need 2 ingredients - self rising flour and cream - to make these delicious and quick biscuits.
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour, plus more for kneading

steps.text: Preheat oven to 500 degrees F (260 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine flour and heavy whipping cream in a bowl and mix until a sticky dough has formed.

Flour a work surface. Knead until dough just comes together and roll dough into a 7-inch circle, about 1/2 inch thick. Dust top with more flour and fold over. Knead and roll again into a 7-inch circle. Be careful not to over-knead the dough.
Cut out biscuits with a biscuit cutter and place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until biscuits start to brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

video.description: Looking for a quick and easy biscuit recipe? Look no further than Two-Ingredient Cream Biscuits! With just two simple ingredients and less than 20 minutes of your time, you can have a batch of delicious biscuits ready to enjoy. Made with self-rising flour and heavy whipping cream, these biscuits are perfect for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. The recipe in this video is easy to follow and requires minimal effort, making it perfect for beginner bakers or those short on time.
